safe_read.description: Read-only inspection of approved non-sensitive surfaces.

safe_generate.description: Generate drafts, summaries, plans, reports, or safe files for Commander review.

review_required.description: Output must be reviewed by Commander before use outside Kingsmen.

approval_required.description: Action changes state, writes files, triggers workflow, sends message, probes portal, or affects operations.

blocked.description: Action is outside Jarvis authority or not safe for automation.
